notes: Breadboard coordinates were read from the image. The catalogue's 't' half (rows a-e) is taken as the lower half of the picture, which is labelled a-e. The 'b' half (rows f-j) is the upper half of the picture.
The potentiometer straddles the centre gap. Its two outer legs sit in 13t.e and 15t.e, and its centre leg sits in 14b.f. A yellow jumper goes from A5 to 14b.j, which is on the wiper strip.
The pot's 5V leg is mapped to VCC and its GND leg to GND. The pot is symmetric, so this could be swapped.

Rail hole numbers (bp.2, bn.1, bp.11, bn.12, bn.25) are estimated from the picture. Each rail is one strip, so the exact hole number does not change the connectivity. The bottom rails of the picture are named bp/bn.
The buzzer's positive leg is assumed to be the one on the A0 side (port 1). The buzzer's other leg goes to GND.
The A0 pin is the DAC output on the UNO R4 Minima. A5 reads the potentiometer.
GND.1 was chosen for the Arduino ground wire.
